method: Read the repaired stems/options without their stored keys, re-read the actual frozen technical bodies, independently re-derive every choice and then inspect all new explanations and generation claims. Semantic judgments and summaries were written anew; only hashes, exact snapshot fields, identities and chronology were bound mechanically.

lifecycleBoundary.independentAssessment: The security/RAG REST-procedure finding was not imported as evidence for these unrelated integration sources. No security candidate was reviewed. The four holds above result from re-reading these candidates' own frozen citations and applying the instruction not to infer GA from enablement, absence of Preview or curator metadata.
lifecycleBoundary.whyNotInherited: The earlier pass accepted GA for these records without affirmative lifecycle support in the cited bodies. That earlier flag is not renewed in this fresh pass. Original reviews remain preserved rather than rewritten.
lifecycleBoundary.noRelabeling: None of these questions is vendor-independent methodology: they name actual DAB or Application Insights behavior. Not applicable is not an evidence-gap workaround. No GA-to-Preview label change is proposed without evidence.
lifecycleBoundary.futureWork: A curator may supply genuinely permitted lifecycle evidence in a separately grounded change. Any authored citation, label or content change requires new generation and both independent reviews; no old hash/date may be refreshed into an approval. No new evidence was fetched or appended to the frozen manifests here.

evidenceReview.ancestry: Retained the complete shared roots and all immediate ancestors: credential course UID -> matching course path UID -> secure learning path -> integration module -> teaching units; cache is directly linked by the entities unit, and Application Insights is explicitly referenced by the monitor unit. Previously inspected actual HTML/MCP root receipts and source registries remain byte-identical to the original pass. No doc-to-doc or course-only technical evidence is used.
sourceLimits: The entities unit's GraphQL caching text conflicts with the current L1 article; it is not used to establish cache behavior.
The objects unit's procedure samples do not substantiate these table-relationship claims or the unrelated SQL REST procedure's maturity.
The monitoring unit's connection-string and alert examples are not treated as proof of complete instrumentation or safe production configuration.
Source status fields stay frozen even where this reviewer cannot affirm the question's corresponding maturity claim.
evidenceReview.sourceAllowlist: Structural testing uses only an in-memory DP-800 clone unioned with exact URLs from the shared root and actual secure source manifests. Source-role, objective, ancestor and chronology gates are unchanged. Structural success cannot fill the four semantic lifecycle gaps.
